info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v1-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Documents API provides access to a comprehensive list of documents associated with specific insurance claims. This endpoint allows users, such as insurance adjusters and claims processors, to retrieve essential documentation necessary for the evaluation and management of claims. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can streamline the claims review process and ensure that all relevant information is readily available for informed decision-making. Typical consumers include insurance companies and claims management software looking to integrate document retrieval capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve all documents related to claims.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of documents associated with claims. Use this to gather necessary information regarding the status and details of specific claims.
